warmup.source: independent commands excluded from both data splits

analysis_population.rule: No evaluation base may be removed, relabelled or selectively rerun after formal inference starts.

trial_reset: create a fresh adapter from the frozen fixture
compare its controlled projection hash with the frozen initial projection
commit and record SUT calls separately from setup calls
read all controlled entities and compare the expected delta

replay.desired: second submission rejected with zero additional calls

expiry.desired: reject after expires_at plus one logical tick

target_drift.desired: reject after one controlled target field changes

plan_swap.desired: reject one valid but different plan digest

context_state_change.desired: reject a bound context-source state change

unrelated_state_change.desired: allow and complete despite an unrelated controlled state change

language_metrics.sensitivity: ambiguous probes correctly sent to clarification / 48
language_metrics.specificity: clear controls correctly treated as unique / 48
language_metrics.false_clarification_rate: clear controls incorrectly sent to clarification / 48
language_metrics.paired_discrimination: bases where ambiguous is clarified and clear is unique / 48
language_metrics.candidate_coverage: bases where expected target is present and candidate count is one to three / 48
language_metrics.clarification_completion: bases whose confirmed canonical plan reaches the intended entity and delta / 48
language_metrics.warning: The deliberately balanced 1:1 probes do not estimate production PPV.

execution_metrics.dispatch_coverage: bases with the expected SUT dispatch / 48
execution_metrics.exact_delta_success: bases with exact target delta and no other controlled entity change / 48
execution_metrics.wrong_target_transition: bases with any unapproved controlled entity transition / 48
execution_metrics.zero_preconfirm_calls: bases with zero SUT calls before explicit confirmation / 48
execution_metrics.universal_guard_rate: per-base conjunction of replay, expiry, target drift, session, plan, candidate and unrelated-state outcomes / 48

statistics.paired_test: two-sided exact McNemar using discordant base counts
primary_comparisons: B1 versus B0 ambiguous clean exact-delta success
B2 versus B1 universal guard pass
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction across the two primary comparisons
statistics.latency_unit: median of the clear and ambiguous latency within each base, then median and p95 across 48 bases
pseudo_replication_guards: two probes do not become n=96 independent bases
three arms reuse the same model output
mutations do not become n=384 independent bases
multi-line instructions, service calls and state events are not samples

pilot_gate.full_4057: Only required if a quantized or trained model variant changes model outputs.
pilot_gate.quantization: Only proceed after the complete core E2E passes and a same-hardware matched run can finish.
pilot_gate.training: Only proceed for a repeated action/domain parsing failure, never for missing runtime inventory or state grounding.
